# Fork Boundary

- This repository is the fork `arhohenschuh/R20Exporter`. Push, tag, release,
  and open issues or pull requests only there (`origin`).
- Never write to the upstream `kakaroto/R20Exporter`: no pushes, tags, issues,
  pull requests, comments, or releases. `upstream` is for fetching only.
- The fork has GitHub issues disabled, and an unqualified `gh issue create` can
  resolve to upstream. Record defects in `docs/bugs/` (Bnnn register) instead.
- Pass `--repo arhohenschuh/R20Exporter` to every `gh` command that writes.
- See [docs/REPOSITORY.md](../docs/REPOSITORY.md) for the clone settings that
  enforce this boundary.
